audio_prompts.purpose: Listening model for a first-semester Fashion Design student introduction.
audio_prompts.script: Hi, my name is Lucas. I am a Fashion Design student. This is my first semester. I have classes in drawing, sewing, patternmaking, creativity, and text production. I like drawing sketches and working with fabric. I want to learn English because I need fashion vocabulary and I want to write better portfolio texts.
audio_prompts.speaker_profile: One young adult Fashion Design student speaking clearly and confidently.
audio_prompts.accent_or_variety: Clear international English suitable for Brazilian A2-B1 learners.
audio_prompts.voice_direction: Friendly, supportive, and easy to follow, with short pauses between ideas.
audio_prompts.suggested_openai_voice_role: Choose an OpenAI or ChatGPT voice available at generation time that sounds like a calm university student.
